title: Specified exchange from coherent coefficient comparisons
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B killed by the prime ell, the continuous-function condensed coefficient ring Lambda of B, any commutative square of separated finite-type k-schemes in the characteristic context of the restricted exchange API, and functors F_T from bounded-below etale B-module complexes to ambient internal Lambda-module complexes on every scheme T, assume coherent pullback and qcqs pushforward isomorphisms satisfying their mate unit and counit identities and the pullback-square coherence equation (CoefficientComparisonData). Then the specified restricted unit, square and counit factors on every bounded constructible realized complex admit a four-vertex comparison with the F-images of the corresponding etale factors; the comparison includes both specified total-arrow factorizations. This is the general formal transport step, with the geometric coefficient construction and underived essential image absent.

source.place: map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app and map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app; exchange component definitions

proof.text: The two vertical maps are qcqs: a separated finite-type scheme over Spec k has compact underlying space, so the maps are quasi-compact; their composites with the separated structure maps are separated, so the maps are separated and hence quasi-separated. Specialize the proved categorical threeStepComparison to the two etale and two internal derived adjunctions. Its coherence hypotheses are exactly P.unit, P.counit and P.square. Reverse its four vertex isomorphisms, proving the reversed square equations by inverse cancellation.

Use the fully faithful restriction formulas for the unit and counit. The inclusion-compatibility isomorphisms are identities. Identify the underlying restricted pullback-composition isomorphisms with leftDerivedUpperStarComp. Work at the isomorphism level to transport inverses, composition and eqToIso across the inclusion; the cached square component equation identifies the result with coefficientAmbientSquare. Project this isomorphism equality to forward maps. The unit, squareTransport and counit component formulas give the three restricted step identities. Use the cached adjunction equation, unfolding the cached functors explicitly so all rewritten terms remain type-correct. In the Sheaf interface, cache the three existing restricted steps as aliases and use their proved defining equations. The equalities coefficientExchangeUnitStep_eq_original, coefficientExchangeSquareStep_eq_original, and coefficientExchangeCounitStep_eq_original certify exactly the original factors, while their implementations remain folded during the comparison check.

Substitute the etale step component lemmas and the three restricted cached-step identities in the reversed categorical comparison. Supply the realized bounded object explicitly to the square equation. Project coefficientExchange_factorization to underlying components for the source factorization; this equation follows from boundedConstructibleBaseChange_eq_unit_square_counit and the three cache equalities. Apply F to Etale.baseChange_app and use map_comp twice for the target factorization. The total internal and etale morphisms remain the specified original exchange maps. No exchange invertibility is asserted.
